name: Titan Autoworx
decisions: Use true Titan red rather than orange for all interactive and lighting accents.
Pair original campaign photography with a subtle procedural 3D garage overlay in the hero.
Keep condensed italic display typography, sharp technical detailing, and restrained radii.
Prioritize real workshop craft, performance builds, and Malta-specific off-road imagery over generic supercar stock.
Keep the homepage hero conversion-focused; place experimental scrollytelling in a dedicated proof-of-craft section below it.

Use Apple-style motion principles for the automotive sequence: direct scroll response, continuous adjacent-frame interpolation, restrained overlays, symmetric disassembly/reassembly, and an accessible static fallback.

Match the approved build boards with a dense workshop editorial layout: sharp two-pixel corners, thin technical borders, compact vertical rhythm, image-led service cards, and the same content hierarchy on mobile.
